Yes. An American citizen generally needs UK work permission to take a healthcare job, including one lasting longer than six months. The Health and Care Worker visa may fit if you’re a qualified healthcare or adult social care professional with an eligible job offer from a Home Office-approved UK employer; the employer must sponsor you. If the role doesn’t qualify for that route, another work visa, such as the Skilled Worker visa, may apply. <citation refs="P3ZezcXb2CceEX0NebZl6,hQ_q7pImE-qqOjCSBcqgA">GOV.UK: Health and Care Worker visa</citation> <citation refs="lT7ZAfYaoDuoInVE6abM_">GOV.UK: Skilled Worker visa</citation>
